title: Filtered colimits preserve weak homotopy equivalences of simplicial sets
statement:
Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $X,Y:I\to\mathrm{sSet}$ be diagrams of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and $f:X\to Y$ a natural transformation. Assume that each $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ is a weak homotopy equivalence, meaning a bijection on path components and isomorphisms on all based homotopy groups after geometric realization [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Then the induced map on degreewise colimits
$$\varinjlim_{i\in I}X_i\longrightarrow\varinjlim_{i\in I}Y_i$$
is a weak homotopy equivalence. No injectivity hypothesis is imposed on the transition maps.
